references.text: The light for the foot and the lamp for the path can be seen as a metaphor for how believers' good deeds shine and guide others.
The way of righteousness that shines like the morning light, growing into full daylight, parallels how believers' light should shine before people.
Jesus as the light of the world, and how followers of Jesus are also to carry this light forward.
The call to have good conduct among the Gentiles, so that they may see the good deeds and glorify God, reflects the message in Matthew 5:16.
